33.FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE TO DIFFERENTLY  ABLED  PERSONS   TO 
APPEAR MAIN EXAMINATION CONDUCTED BY UPSC/TNPSC – GROUP – I 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
 
 
A sum of Rs.50,000/- is given to the differently  
abled  persons   for appearing the main 
examination conducted by the UPSC and TNPSC 
(Group-I Service) 
 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria for admission 
 
 
 
1. Differently abled with 40% and above 
disability 
2. Should have passed the preliminary exam. 
3. Pursuing coaching in Government 
approved coaching centre. 
4. Not employed in State/Central/Government 
PSU 
 
3. 
Whether the prescribed 
application form  is available. 
 
No 
4. 
Certificate to be furnished 
 
 
 
1. National identity card. 
2. Proof for having passed the preliminary 
exam. 
3. Certificate from the coaching centre. 
5. 
Officer to whom the application is 
to be submitted 
 
 
The Commissioner for Welfare of the  Differently 
Abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940

Grievances if any to be 
addressed to
